   <div id="exportBox" style="display:none; margin-top:10px;">
        <textarea id="exportText" readonly style="width:100%; min-height:120px; font-family:monospace; font-size:11px; direction:ltr; text-align:left;"></textarea>
        <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:#546670; margin-top:6px; line-height:1.6;">
          انسخي هذا الكود وابعتيه لي في المحادثة، وهثبّت هذه المواضع في الملف نفسه بشكل دائم.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="hint">
        الصورة الأصلية للتفويض لا تتغير إطلاقًا — البيانات تُكتب فوقها فقط في المكان المخصص. إذا احتجت تعديل موضع أي حقل بدقة أكبر، اسحبه بالماوس مباشرة فوق الصورة، ثم اضغطي "نسخ المواضع الحالية" وابعتي الكود لي لأثبّته نهائيًا.
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ================= DOCUMENT ================= -->
    <div class="doc-holder">
      <div class="doc" id="doc">
        <img id="docImg" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="نموذج التفويض">

        <div class="field-box" id="b_date"    data-maxw="30" style="top:16.3464%; height:3.2%; right:76.8802%; width:max-content; max-width:30%;"><span></span></div>
        <div class="field-box" id="b_company" data-maxw="55" style="top:17.3458%; height:3.2%; right:14.8438%; width:max-content; max-width:55%;"><span></span></div>
        <div class="field-box" id="b_driver"  data-maxw="50" style="top:31.8856%; height:3.2%; right:10.2764%; width:max-content; max-width:50%;"><span></span></div>
        <div class="field-box" id="b_carno"   data-maxw="50" style="top:34.7766%; height:3.2%; right:13.762%; width:max-content; max-width:50%;"><span></span></div>
        <div class="field-box" id="b_license" data-maxw="50" style="top:37.7526%; height:3.2%; right:10.1562%; width:max-content; max-width:50%;"><span></span></div>
        <div class="field-box" id="b_spec" data-maxw="80" style="top:62.0707%; height:3.4%; right:5.10817%; width:max-content; max-width:80%; justify-content:center; color:#d81015; font-weight:800;"><span></span></div>
        <div class="field-box" id="b_notes"   data-maxw="96" style="top:61.1354%; height:3.2%; right:44.2909%; width:max-content; max-width:96%;"><span></span></div>

        <div id="b_loading_wrap" style="position:absolute; top:49.5%; right:8%; width:60%; direction:rtl;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
const APP_PASSWORD = 'elshark2026';

function tryUnlock(){
  const val = document.getElementById('lockInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const err = document.getElementById('lockError');
  if (val === APP_PASSWORD){
    document.getElementById('lockScreen').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('appContent').classList.remove('locked');
    err.textContent = '';
    scaleFont();
  } else {
    err.textContent = 'كلمة المرور غير صحيحة، حاولي مرة أخرى';
    document.getElementById('lockInput').value = '';
    document.getElementById('lockInput').focus();
  }
}
document.getElementById('lockBtn').addEventListener('click', tryUnlock);
document.getElementById('lockInput').addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if (e.key === 'Enter') tryUnlock();
});
window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{ document.getElementById('lockInput').focus(); });

const map = [
  ['f_date','b_date'],
  ['f_company','b_company'],
  ['f_driver','b_driver'],
  ['f_carno','b_carno'],
  ['f_license','b_license'],
  ['f_notes','b_notes'],
];

function sync(){
  map.forEach(([inputId, boxId])=>{
    const val = document.getElementById(inputId).value;
    document.getElementById(boxId).querySelector('span').textContent = val;
  });

  // specification line: "مواصفة {value}"
  const specVal = document.getElementById('f_spec').value.trim();
  const specBox = document.getElementById('b_spec');
  specBox.querySelector('span').textContent = specVal ? ('مواصفة ' + specVal) : '';

  renderLoadingList();
  fitAllText();
}

function renderLoadingList(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('b_loading_wrap');
  const raw = document.getElementById('f_loading').value;
  const lines = raw.split('\n').map(l=>l.trim()).filter(l=>l.length>0);
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  const docEl = document.getElementById('doc');
  const docH = docEl.clientHeight || 1;
  const rowGapPct = lines.length > 5 ? (16 / lines.length) : 3.2; // shrink spacing if many lines
  const rowGapPx = docH * (rowGapPct / 100);
  const rowHeightPx = docH * 0.031;
  lines.forEach((line, idx)=>{
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'field-box loading-row';
    row.dataset.maxw = '60';
    row.dataset.topPct = (idx * rowGapPct);
    row.style.position = 'absolute';
    row.style.top = (idx * rowGapPx) + 'px';
    row.style.right = '0';
    row.style.width = 'max-content';
    row.style.maxWidth = '100%';
    row.style.height = rowHeightPx + 'px';
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.textContent = line;
    row.appendChild(span);
    wrap.appendChild(row);
  });
}

function scaleFont(){
  const docEl = document.getElementById('doc');
  const w = docEl.clientWidth;
  // base font size relative to document width, tuned for the template
  const fs = Math.max(10, w * 0.019);
  document.querySelectorAll('.field-box').forEach(el=>{
    el.dataset.baseFont = fs;
    el.style.fontSize = fs + 'px';
  });
  fitAllText();
}

function fitAllText(){
  const docEl = document.getElementById('doc');
  const docW = docEl.clientWidth;
  document.querySelectorAll('.field-box').forEach(box=>{
    const span = box.querySelector('span');
    if(!span) return;
    const base = parseFloat(box.dataset.baseFont) || Math.max(10, docW * 0.019);
    let fs = base;
    box.style.fontSize = fs + 'px';
    const maxwPct = parseFloat(box.dataset.maxw) || 90;
    const maxWidth = docW * (maxwPct / 100);
    let guard = 0;
    while (span.scrollWidth > maxWidth && fs > Math.max(7.5, base * 0.3) && guard < 60){
      fs -= 0.4;
      box.style.fontSize = fs + 'px';
      guard++;
    }
  });
}

map.forEach(([inputId])=>{
  document.getElementById(inputId).addEventListener('input', sync);
});
document.getElementById('f_loading').addEventListener('input', sync);
document.getElementById('f_spec').addEventListener('input', sync);

window.addEventListener('resize', scaleFont);
window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{ scaleFont(); sync(); });

document.getElementById('clearBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  map.forEach(([inputId])=>{ document.getElementById(inputId).value=''; });
  document.getElementById('f_loading').value = '';
  document.getElementById('f_spec').value = '';
  sync();
});

document.getElementById('printBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  window.print();
});

document.getElementById('exportBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  const ids = ['b_date','b_company','b_driver','b_carno','b_license','b_spec','b_notes'];
  let lines = [];
  ids.forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    lines.push(id + ' | top:' + el.style.top + ' right:' + el.style.right + ' width:' + el.style.width + ' height:' + el.style.height);
  });
  const wrap = document.getElementById('b_loading_wrap');
  lines.push('b_loading_wrap | top:' + wrap.style.top + ' right:' + wrap.style.right + ' width:' + wrap.style.width);
  const fullText = lines.join('\n');

  const box = document.getElementById('exportBox');
  const text = document.getElementById('exportText');
  text.value = fullText;
  box.style.display = 'block';
  box.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});
  text.focus();
  text.select();

  // try auto-copy to clipboard as a convenience; ignore failures silently
  if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullText).catch(()=>{});
  }

  // guaranteed-visible fallback in case the panel is out of view or hidden on this device
  window.alert('تم إنشاء كود المواضع. انسخيه من المربع الظاهر أسفل الأزرار وابعتيه هنا:\n\n' + fullText);
});

document.getElementById('downloadBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  const btn = document.getElementById('downloadBtn');
  btn.textContent = 'جارٍ التحضير...';
  try {
    const canvas = renderFinalCanvas();
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.download = 'تفويض_تحميل.png';
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    link.click();
    btn.textContent = 'تحميل الصورة النهائية (PNG)';
  } catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    btn.textContent = 'تحميل الصورة النهائية (PNG)';
    alert('حدث خطأ أثناء إنشاء الصورة، برجاء المحاولة مرة أخرى.');
  }
});

/* Native canvas renderer — draws the background image plus each field's text
   using the browser's own text engine (ctx.fillText), which shapes Arabic
   letters correctly, unlike html2canvas which breaks Arabic letter joining.
   This also removes any need for an external library, so export works fully offline. */
function renderFinalCanvas(){
  const img = document.getElementById('docImg');
  const QUALITY = 2.4; // multiplier over the base image resolution
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = Math.round(img.naturalWidth * QUALITY);
  canvas.height = Math.round(img.naturalHeight * QUALITY);
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  const baseFontPx = Math.max(12, canvas.width * 0.019);
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.direction = 'rtl';

  function drawField(topPct, rightPct, maxwPct, text, opts){
    if (!text) return;
    opts = opts || {};
    const color = opts.color || '#111111';
    const weight = opts.weight || '700';
    const heightPct = opts.heightPct || 3.2;
    const yPx = canvas.height * ((topPct + heightPct/2) / 100);
    const xRightEdgePx = canvas.width * ((100 - rightPct) / 100);
    const maxWidthPx = canvas.width * ((maxwPct || 90) / 100);

    let fs = baseFontPx * (opts.scale || 1);
    ctx.font = `${weight} ${fs}px Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif`;
    let guard = 0;
    while (ctx.measureText(text).width > maxWidthPx && fs > baseFontPx * 0.3 && guard < 60){
      fs -= 0.6;
      ctx.font = `${weight} ${fs}px Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif`;
      guard++;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(text, xRightEdgePx, yPx);
  }

  const fieldIds = [
    ['b_date', null],
    ['b_company', null],
    ['b_driver', null],
    ['b_carno', null],
    ['b_license', null],
    ['b_notes', null],
  ];
  fieldIds.forEach(([id])=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    const span = el.querySelector('span');
    const text = span ? span.textContent.trim() : '';
    const topPct = parseFloat(el.style.top);
    const rightPct = parseFloat(el.style.right);
    const heightPct = parseFloat(el.style.height) || 3.2;
    const maxwPct = parseFloat(el.dataset.maxw) || 90;
    drawField(topPct, rightPct, maxwPct, text, {heightPct});
  });

  // specification line — red, bold
  const specEl = document.getElementById('b_spec');
  const specSpan = specEl.querySelector('span');
  const specText = specSpan ? specSpan.textContent.trim() : '';
  drawField(
    parseFloat(specEl.style.top),
    parseFloat(specEl.style.right),
    parseFloat(specEl.dataset.maxw) || 80,
    specText,
    {heightPct: parseFloat(specEl.style.height) || 3.4, color:'#d81015', weight:'800'}
  );

  // multi-line loading list
  const wrap = document.getElementById('b_loading_wrap');
  const wrapTopPct = parseFloat(wrap.style.top);
  const wrapRightPct = parseFloat(wrap.style.right);
  document.querySelectorAll('.loading-row').forEach(row=>{
    const span = row.querySelector('span');
    const text = span ? span.textContent.trim() : '';
    const rowTopPct = wrapTopPct + (parseFloat(row.dataset.topPct) || 0);
    const maxwPct = parseFloat(row.dataset.maxw) || 60;
    drawField(rowTopPct, wrapRightPct, maxwPct, text, {heightPct:3.1});
  });

  return canvas;
}

/* ---- drag to fine-tune position of each field box ---- */
(function enableDrag(){
  const doc = document.getElementById('doc');
  document.querySelectorAll('.field-box').forEach(box=>{
    box.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
    box.style.cursor = 'move';
    box.addEventListener('mousedown', startDrag);
    box.addEventListener('touchstart', startDrag, {passive:false});
  });

  function startDrag(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const box = e.currentTarget;
    const rect = doc.getBoundingClientRect();
    function move(ev){
      const point = ev.touches ? ev.touches[0] : ev;
      let xPct = ((point.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
      let yPct = ((point.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;
      const rightPct = 100 - xPct;
      box.style.right = Math.max(0, Math.min(95, rightPct)) + '%';
      box.style.top = Math.max(0, Math.min(98, yPct)) + '%';
    }
    function up(){
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', up);
      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('touchend', up);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', move, {passive:false});
    document.addEventListener('touchend', up);
  }
})();

/* ---- drag the whole loading list block together ---- */
(function enableDragWrap(){
  const doc = document.getElementById('doc');
  const wrap = document.getElementById('b_loading_wrap');
  wrap.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  wrap.style.cursor = 'move';
  wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', startDrag);
  wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', startDrag, {passive:false});

  function startDrag(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const rect = doc.getBoundingClientRect();
    function move(ev){
      const point = ev.touches ? ev.touches[0] : ev;
      let xPct = ((point.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
      let yPct = ((point.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;
      const rightPct = 100 - xPct;
      wrap.style.right = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, rightPct)) + '%';
      wrap.style.top = Math.max(0, Math.min(90, yPct)) + '%';
    }
    function up(){
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', up);
      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', move);
      document.removeEventListener('touchend', up);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', move, {passive:false});
    document.addEventListener('touchend', up);
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
